'''Dex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an officer in the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. He was stationed aboard the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Darth Caedus]], the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], during the [[Battle of Uroro Station]], at the time of the battle serving as a guard in the ''Solo''{{'s}} brig. He possessed a similar appearance to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Zekk]].
